answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, which means holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in fable and nebula lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the island graph. A farm of 2455 identities would post 2723 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
